title: Flipped Jeep SMP
description: This is the official modpack for the Flipped Jeep SMP. Here is where all the updates and mod list can be found. no more sketchy files. no more trust issues. no more fun.
body:
Built for the Flipped Jeep Discord crew, this modpack blends technology and exploration into one big sandbox. If you’ve ever wanted to play Satisfactory inside Minecraft, this is about as close as you’ll get without welding conveyor belts in your living room.

Highlights
– Engineering Focus: Create, Immersive Engineering, PneumaticCraft, and dozens of add-ons that let you build machines, automate processes, and design contraptions beyond vanilla limits.
– Exploration & Adventure: Expanded biomes, dungeons, the Better End and unusual End mods, and visual upgrades like Distant Horizons to make the world feel massive.
– Quality of Life: Backpack mods, performance optimizations, enhanced sounds, minimaps, trade cycling, and a voice chat system so your team can coordinate (or argue) in real time.
– Community Ready: Designed for multiplayer fun on our server, but anyone who loves engineering, exploration, and teamwork will feel at home.

Build, explore, engineer, and discover. Whether you’re designing a mega-factory, charting new lands, or just hanging out with friends, this pack is here to make Minecraft bigger, smarter, and more fun.


This modpack makes use of the following third-party projects. All rights belong to their original authors. Where required, attribution and links to the original project pages are provided.
